param: aβ Number of infectious bites delivered per vector per day (combined biting rate and transmission probability)
bᵥ Number of eggs laid per female mosquito per day
p Percentage of female adults among emerging vectors
Nₕ_initial Initial human population for calculating transmission rate
δ Larvae mortality rate due to limited carrying capacity (parameter for non-linear term, not used directly in flows)
Kᵥ Carrying capacity for larvae (parameter for non-linear term, not used directly in flows)
transmission_rate Transmission rate per contact, adjusted for human and alternative host populations
maturation_to_female_vector Effective maturation rate from pupa to susceptible female adult vector
